gaps.title: Mining-Specific Natural Language Vibration Diagnosis
gaps.pain: Maintenance teams struggle to translate complex vibration data and dashboards into actionable maintenance decisions, leading to delayed responses and reliance on scarce expert analysts.
gaps.why_now: Advances in NLP make it technically feasible to generate domain-specific, clear recommendations, while established mining vibration providers (e.g., Bently Nevada) still rely on rule-based outputs and pure-play AI startups (e.g., Augury) are just beginning to enter mining.
gaps.evidence_needed: Customer discovery with mining maintenance managers to quantify time lost interpreting data and gauge willingness to pay for explainable NLP outputs; competitive analysis of Augury's mining traction.
gaps.risk: Augury accelerates mining deployment with its strong NLP and funding; incumbents may add NLP features to existing dashboards.

gaps.title: Lightweight Edge-Native PdM for Remote Sites
gaps.pain: Remote mines often lack reliable connectivity, causing latency or failure in cloud-based predictive maintenance, yet many solutions assume constant cloud access.
gaps.why_now: Edge computing hardware is increasingly affordable and powerful, enabling on-site processing of vibration data and real-time NLP recommendations without connectivity dependence.
gaps.evidence_needed: Pilot deployment at a mine with intermittent connectivity to measure impact on uptime and maintenance response time; analysis of connectivity costs and downtime losses.
gaps.risk: Hardware integration complexity and maintenance overhead; satellite IoT solutions may reduce connectivity gaps.

gaps.title: Integrated Vibration and Process Data Recommendations
gaps.pain: Vibration data alone is often insufficient to diagnose root causes; maintenance teams need correlated context from process parameters, but current tools treat them in silos.
gaps.why_now: Increasing sensorization in mining provides access to rich process data, and AI can fuse these streams for more accurate, holistic diagnostics.
gaps.evidence_needed: Case studies from mining operations where vibration-only diagnostics failed; assessment of data integration challenges and improvement in recommendation accuracy from fusion.
gaps.risk: Data integration is technically complex and requires buy-in from multiple equipment vendors; incumbents may leverage existing platform breadth to add fusion.

gaps.title: Bridging the Skills Gap with Explainable AI
gaps.pain: The mining industry faces a severe shortage of experienced vibration analysts; junior technicians lack the expertise to interpret advanced analytics, slowing adoption of predictive maintenance.
gaps.why_now: Aging workforce and declining vocational expertise create an urgent need for AI that not only predicts but educates and guides less-experienced staff.
gaps.evidence_needed: Interviews with training managers and HR at mining companies to quantify skills gap; user testing of prototype NLP recommendations with technicians to measure comprehension and trust.
gaps.risk: Over-reliance on AI recommendations may reduce attention to unusual scenarios; user trust must be carefully built.

gaps.title: Pre-Built Mining Asset Model Library with Explainability
gaps.pain: Deploying predictive maintenance on mining-specific assets (mills, crushers, haul trucks) requires extensive custom modeling, causing months of delay and high consulting costs.
gaps.why_now: Few vendors offer out-of-the-box, explainable models tuned for common mining assets; a library of pre-built models dramatically accelerates time-to-value.
gaps.evidence_needed: Benchmark deployment time and cost for custom PdM models versus a pre-built library; surveys with mining operations on willingness to adopt off-the-shelf models vs. bespoke.
gaps.risk: Mining asset diversity may limit the transferability of pre-built models; competitors may build similar libraries from accumulated data.

gaps.title: Compliance-Ready PdM with Audit Trail
gaps.pain: Regulatory and safety standards increasingly require documented evidence of maintenance decisions; most PdM tools generate alerts without transparent reasoning logs suitable for audits.
gaps.why_now: ESG pressures and stricter mining regulations demand justifiable, explainable maintenance actions to avoid penalties and demonstrate due diligence.
gaps.evidence_needed: Review of regulatory requirements in key mining jurisdictions; interviews with safety and compliance officers to assess current pain in audit preparation.
gaps.risk: May be perceived as a nice-to-have rather than a must-have by maintenance teams; requires close alignment with evolving regulations.

checkpoint_instruction: Conduct 5–10 structured interviews with mining maintenance managers to validate time spent interpreting vibration dashboards, quantify the cost of misdiagnosis, and test willingness to pay for NLP-generated recommendations. Build a minimal prototype of vibration-to-text pipeline using publicly available bearing datasets and a pre-trained LLM to demonstrate mining-specific explainability.
